title: Moving Generality from Model to Modeler: LLM Agents for PHM on a Deployment-Style Benchmark
abstract: arXiv:2611.25252v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Coding agents built on large language models (LLMs) now help develop many models published as general solutions. Should generality instead reside in the agent that builds a model for each new task? We examine this question in prognostics and health management (PHM), where every model must work on unseen equipment. Our deployment-style benchmark, NextUnit-Bench, covers 24 public datasets split into 58 folds that hold out units or operating conditions; each agent has two hours to deliver an executable predictor, then run on the hidden units. First, frontier agents outperform AutoML, which reaches less than half the best agent's score, and faithful implementations of published methods on four datasets, of which only 6 of 30 beat the strongest agent's own design; published accuracies, where reproducible, rest on the papers' own conventions, and a single convention, capping the remaining life of test engines, can halve the reported error. translated_title: 将通用性从模型转移到建模者：在部署式基准上用于PHM（故障预测与健康管理）的LLM智能体
translated_abstract: 基于大语言模型（LLM）构建的编程智能体如今帮助开发了许多作为通用解决方案发布的模型。那么，通用性是否应改为体现在为每个新任务构建模型的智能体之中？我们在故障预测与健康管理（PHM）领域考察了这一问题，因为在该领域中每个模型都必须在未见过的设备上工作。我们提出的部署式基准 NextUnit-Bench 涵盖 24 个公开数据集，划分为 58 个折，分别对设备单元或运行条件进行留出；每个智能体有两个小时时间交付一个可执行的预测器，随后在隐藏单元上进行测试。首先，前沿智能体的表现优于 AutoML——后者的得分不到最佳智能体的一半——也优于在四个数据集上对已发表方法的忠实实现，30 个实现中仅有 6 个击败了最强智能体自行设计的方案；在可复现的情况下，已发表的准确率依赖于论文自身的约定，而仅仅一个约定——对测试引擎的剩余寿命进行上限截断——就可能使报告的误差减半。
tldr: 该论文提出部署式基准 NextUnit-Bench，证明基于LLM的智能体在PHM任务上可超越AutoML及已发表方法的忠实复现，主张通用性应从单一模型转移到能为每个新任务构建模型的智能体身上。
en_tdlr: Proposing the deployment-style benchmark NextUnit-Bench, this paper shows that LLM agents outperform AutoML and faithful implementations of published methods on PHM tasks, arguing that generality should move from models to the model-building agents themselves.
